summary: Reduce architecture coupling around the turret Base aggregate without changing gameplay, registry identities, persistence keys, network payload schemas or client/server semantics.

authoritative_state: TurretBaseBlockEntity remains the owner of mutable inventory, energy, trust, attachment state and persistence state.
TurretHeadBlockEntity remains the owner of cooldown, target presentation and aim persistence state.
Targeting and combat services execute on the server thread and do not hold or callback TurretHeadBlockEntity.

fields: Existing Base save/load keys remain unchanged, including legacy active/mode reads.
Existing Head cooldown, aim and priority keys remain unchanged.
Existing Projectile context keys remain unchanged.
Real old-save load and save/load round-trip are required after every persistence-affecting slice.

flows.purpose: Preserve existing tracking BlockEntity updates and bounded aim/Beam visual events while keeping recipient scope explicit.
validation: Payload type, registration ID, field order and encoding stay unchanged.
No new per-tick full BlockEntity broadcast is introduced.
Tracking recipients and packet counts are compared with the phase-0 ledger.

client_boundary.dedicated_server_fallback: All common/server services run without loading client-only classes.

budgets.scope: 100 turret bases, 100 turret heads and 100 fixed targets after 200 tick warmup
budgets.measurement: The fixed fixture records 200 server-thread tick intervals with System.nanoTime; candidate median p95 may increase no more than 10 percent over the phase-0 baseline, with an absolute 0.25 ms floor when baseline p95 is below 1 ms. JFR ServerTickTime and ExecutionSample are independent corroboration.

hot_paths: TurretBaseBlockEntity server tick and attachment views
performance.measurement_environment: Fixed Windows host, Java 21, NeoForge 21.1.234, identical JVM/config/workspace protocol, three baseline and three candidate runs.

mods.fallback: The mod refuses to load outside the pinned NeoForge 21.1 line.

criteria.statement: Existing gameplay behavior, registry IDs, payload schemas and client/server boundaries remain unchanged.
criteria.observation: Existing behavior GameTests, static gate and dedicated-server smoke pass after each code slice.

criteria.statement: Base, Head and Projectile persistence keys remain readable and round-trip without loss.
criteria.observation: Key ledger, statePersistence GameTest and real old-save load/save/reload all pass.

criteria.statement: Services have explicit one-way boundaries, pure rule inputs are separated from server world queries, and no service calls back into Head.
criteria.observation: Contract audit, static inspection and behavior tests agree on the dependency graph.

criteria.statement: Existing attachment, range and capacity caches retain correct keys and invalidation behavior; no duplicate cache owner is introduced.
criteria.observation: Phase-0 cache ledger and attachment/capacity GameTests pass before and after any cache-related slice.

criteria.statement: The fixed 100/100 pressure scenario does not regress server tick p95 beyond the declared budget.
criteria.observation: Three baseline and three candidate fixture/JFR runs complete and compare within threshold.

covers: Every contract test_id maps to a real method, script or gate command and is not mistaken for a pass claim.
tests.expected: All declared test executors resolve; execution_status remains explicitly not_evaluated until the corresponding evidence run.

covers: Existing gameplay behavior and target/combat orchestration remain unchanged.
Base, Head and Projectile persistence keys remain readable and round-trip without loss.
tests.expected: State persistence assertions pass in the real GameTest run.

covers: The real old-save fixture loads, saves and reloads with key/value ledger agreement.
tests.expected: The copied old-save fixture completes two graceful server passes without source-world mutation.

covers: One-way service boundaries and common/client physical separation.
tests.expected: Static gate passes with zero errors and zero warnings.

covers: Attachment topology and placement behavior remain unchanged.
Derived capacity behavior remains unchanged while cache ownership is reviewed.
The fixed 100/100 pressure scenario does not regress server tick p95 beyond the declared budget.
tests.expected: Baseline and candidate runs produce complete fixture metrics and JFR evidence within the threshold.

covers: The common/server graph does not load client-only classes.
tests.expected: Dedicated server reaches completion without client classloading or runtime errors.

covers: DataGen and asset layout remain stable during architecture changes.
tests.expected: Static and asset gates pass; any DataGen diff is intentional and reviewed.

steps: Run one client session after automation is complete.
Check GUI energy/configuration, Jade, Shift tooltip, Beam and projectile visuals.
Change world, disconnect to menu, reconnect, run F3+T, then exit normally.
manual_checks.expected: Existing client behavior remains unchanged and no client-only state leaks across world or connection boundaries.

non_goals: Changing turret balance, configuration defaults, registry IDs, save keys or network payload fields.
Splitting TurretProjectileEntity movement or tracking without profiler evidence.
Changing or iterating the external .agents toolkit.
Replacing final manual client acceptance with AI or server-only tests.
Creating a second owner for Base inventory, energy, attachment or persistence state.
